---
title: "Quarter pacing: Modules 1–7"
---

This 10-week plan combines class meetings with separate lab preparation. PCA receives two weeks; use the semester plan if learners need more R practice.

| Week | Preparation (60–90 min) | Class meeting (150–180 min) | Product |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Setup, reproducibility checks, Module 1 concepts | Matrix anatomy, sparse representations, manual library metrics | Count-matrix interpretation memo |
| 2 | Module 1 undersampling sections; begin Module 2 | Sampling zeros, ambient RNA, empty droplets, doublets; QC visualizations | Controlled undersampling comparison |
| 3 | Module 2 threshold sections | Permissive/moderate/aggressive QC lab and downstream comparison | QC sensitivity report |
| 4 | Module 3 conceptual and hand-calculation sections | Manual normalization, Seurat reproduction, scale-factor perturbation | Normalization worksheet |
| 5 | Module 3 SCTransform section | LogNormalize-versus-SCTransform comparison and synthesis discussion | Foundational analysis audit |
| 6 | Module 4 | HVG arithmetic, mean–variance trend, feature-count sensitivity | Feature-selection report |
| 7 | Module 5 | Scaling, reference population, regression | Scaling and regression comparison |
| 8 | Module 6 geometry | Loadings, scores, orthogonality, reconstruction | Manual projection and geometry |
| 9 | Module 6 population comparison | Whole-immune versus T-cell PCA; variance and interpretation | PC evidence table |
| 10 | Module 7 | Fixed-resolution dims experiment and cross-module synthesis | Defended representation choice |

Allow the modules' stated lab time outside the class meeting. No later module is required by this plan.
